srList.sentence: 2.6.6 Stability The stability of analytes in plasma was investigated with the HQC and LQC samples (6 replicates for each) at room temperature for 4 h, at 4 degC for 4 h, in the autosampler for 24 h after sample processing, for three freeze-thaw cycles from -40 degC to room temperature, and for long-term storage for 30 d at -40 degC.
